name: gym-routine-app
description: Monorepo root (npm workspaces): shared contract, server API and client web

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names shared,api,web --prefix-colors magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w shared && npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
